parameters.jsCode: let input=$json.body ?? $json; if(typeof input==='string'){input=JSON.parse(input);} const required=['case_id','decision','approver','rationale','evidence_hash']; const missing=required.filter(k=>!input[k]); if(missing.length) throw new Error('MISSING_GOVERNANCE_FIELDS:'+missing.join(',')); if(!['APPROVE','REJECT'].includes(input.decision)) throw new Error('INVALID_DECISION'); const approved=input.decision==='APPROVE'; const ts=new Date().toISOString(); return [{json:{ok:true,case_id:input.case_id,statement_id:input.statement_id||'RINV-2026-008',decision:approved?'APPROVED':'REJECTED',status:approved?'POSTED_TO_GOVERNED_LEDGER':'BLOCKED_BY_GOVERNANCE',approver:input.approver,rationale:input.rationale,evidence_hash:input.evidence_hash,policy_version:'CLAIMGUARD-1.3',decided_at:ts,receipt_id:`${approved?'APR':'REJ'}-${input.case_id}-${Date.now()}`,external_action_executed:false,message:approved?'Attribution approved and posted. Supplier transmission remains disabled.':'Attribution rejected. No supplier charge was created.'}}];
